measurement: inclusive elapsed wall time, not CPU time
scope: main entry to return, including startup, workload, drain and shutdown; not just the five-second busy window
limitations: synchronous handlers only; nested spans overlap and must not be summed; includes blocking, descheduling and profiler overhead; excludes uninstrumented workers and async waits

counter_semantics.feedBytes: bytes offered to Engine.feed, including failed calls
counter_semantics.paneVisits: sync Pane.poll calls or native Pane.output calls, not unique panes
counter_semantics.childChecks: Session.try_wait calls including cached status; excludes Drop direct child.try_wait
